items.title: ESG Today: Week in Review
items.summary: This week in ESG news: EU publishes final revised sustainability reporting standards; Glass Lewis merges with Clarity AI to form unified stewardship and sustainability data platform; Bain survey finds rebounding consumer concern on sustainability, increasing sustainable consumption behavior; Schroders launches new framework to identify and assess climate adaptation investment opportunities; EU to launch sustainability criteria, labels for data centers; Germany unveils plan to exit fossil fuels by 2045; New York’s inaugural ESG bond offering; MSCI’s new Head of Sustainability, and more.
